## Activity

This report covers activity at Hill Counties Health Centre during October 2021. The site recorded 51 captures during the month. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the period.

The activity record provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. No additional activity figures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 51 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 9.8 per cent. This measure records the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. The result is reported alongside the capture total to provide a clear view of image quality at Hill Counties Health Centre during October 2021.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 3 days. This is the median time between the capture being made and the grading outcome being recorded.

Together, these results summarise the site’s activity, image quality and grading performance for October 2021.
